history.summary: Freehold 3,874 sqft '4BR' at St Michael Regency, D12 (Potong Pasir), asking $3.9M at $1,007 PSF. The very low PSF reflects an enormous strata floor area (likely penthouse/duplex with large void/PES), not a bargain — the $3.9M quantum is well outside the liquid band.
history.rating_rationale: $1,007 PSF vs $1,706 median looks like a 40% discount, but 3,874 sqft is exceptionally large — the cheap PSF is a sizing artefact, and the $3.9M absolute quantum dramatically shrinks the buyer pool. Only 13 URA txns make the 9.17%/yr rate unreliable, the development is small (Potong Pasir boutique), and 1.06km to MRT is poor. As an investment with 5-7yr exit, illiquidity at this quantum is the dominant risk.
red_flags: $3.9M quantum — very thin buyer pool, hard exit
Only 13 URA txns — appreciation rate unreliable
3,874 sqft oversized unit — low PSF is a sizing illusion
catalysts: Potong Pasir gentrification, near-city D12 location
